name: parents_evening_schedule
description: A family's parents' evening appointments (siblings together), one per contact address.
subject: Your appointments: {event_name} on {event_date}
body: Here are your appointments for {event_name} on {event_date} ({venue}).
Each appointment lasts {slot_minutes} minutes - please arrive a few minutes early.
If you can no longer attend, please let the school office know.

placeholders.venue: Where (room, or online with the link)
placeholders.appointments: One line per appointment: time, teacher (room), child
